2609.19519.title: An Architecture for Long-Horizon Agents: Levels, Ticks and Cascaded Intelligence
2609.19519.paper_summary: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out work spanning days or weeks, such as an operations remediation or a research programme. Such a task outlives any context window, any process and any interval at which a person can attend. In this paper, we argue that a long-horizon agent must run continually without forgetting before it can learn continually. This ability lies in the harness around the model rather than in the model itself. We derive seven bottlenecks from the long-horizon setting and answer them with a hierarchical architecture of three parts: (i) levels indexed by time scale, each keeping a bounded file summarising the level below; (ii) a clocked tick as the unit of autonomous action; and (iii) cascaded intelligence, where work is escalated to a more capable model only after failing review. We report on a ten-day campaign in which an agent built on this architecture reproduced a published reinforcement-learning result with a human attending once a day, and show (1) the agent kept the thread across every context reset and session boundary of the campaign, (2) operating knowledge written early changed later behaviour with no change to model weights, and (3) where learned components would enter such a system. Overall, our experience suggests continual learning for these agents needs a substrate outliving every context and process, and the checks the harness already runs are where a learner belongs.
2609.19519.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型代理越來越多地被要求執行跨越數天或數週的工作，例如操作修復或研究計劃。這樣的任務超出了任何上下文窗口、任何過程和任何人可以參與的時間間隔。在本文中，我們主張一個長期代理必須不斷運行而不會遺忘，才能持續學習。這種能力在於模型周圍的結構，而不是模型本身。我們從長期設定中推導出七個瓶頸，並通過三個部分的分層架構來解決它們：（i）按時間尺度索引的層級，每個層級保持一個有界的文件，總結下面的層級；（ii）作為自主行動單位的計時滴答；以及（iii）級聯智能，工作僅在未通過審查後才提升到更有能力的模型。我們報告了一個十天的活動，其中基於這一架構的代理在每天有一位人類參與的情況下重現了一個已發表的強化學習結果，並顯示（1）代理在活動的每次上下文重置和會話邊界之間保持了主線，（2）早期寫入的操作知識改變了後來的行為，而模型權重沒有變化，及（3）學習的組件會進入這樣的系統的地方。總體而言，我們的經驗表明，這些代理的持續學習需要一種超越每個上下文和過程的基底，而目前結構所運行的檢查正是學習者所屬的地方。
